backend/main.mo: Main backend actor implementing fuel station management with types for tanks, sales, expenses, staff, shifts, and cash collections; includes Stripe payment integration, access control with role-based permissions, and CRUD operations for all entities.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting two implemented features: owner/admin login with access control for entry management, and automatic serial number display in staff management interface when Principal IDs are modified.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components including sales reporting, analytics, offline support for sales/expenses, staff management with Principal ID editing, payment flows, and connection monitoring with auto-sync capabilities.
frontend/index.css: Global CSS with Tailwind directives and OKLCH color system variables defining light and dark theme design tokens for the fuel station management application.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script import for the React application titled 'Fuel Inventory Management'.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application with TanStack Router setup, AuthGuard for Internet Identity authentication, ProfileSetup modal for new users, and routes for all dashboard features including tanks, sales, staff, shifts, expenses, and analytics.
frontend/src/components/AlertsPanel.tsx: Alerts dashboard displaying active low-fuel tank alerts and normal-status tanks with refill calculations, threshold comparisons, and links to update tank levels.
Displays visual analytics for sales data using line and bar charts, showing sales trends over time, fuel type comparisons by revenue/volume, and transaction counts.
frontend/src/components/CashCollectionEn: Manages cash collection recording with a form to log amounts and breakdowns, displays collection history, and shows reconciliation between today's sales revenue and collected cash with discrepancy tracking.
frontend/src/components/CommissionCalcul: Calculates and displays staff commissions based on sales performance, showing a breakdown table with sales counts, total sales, commission rates, and earned commissions per staff member.
frontend/src/components/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard component showing overview cards for active alerts, current shift status, today's sales revenue, and tank status with clickable links to detailed views.
Layout wrapper providing sidebar navigation with menu items for all app sections, user profile display, admin-only sections, offline status indicator, and logout functionality.
frontend/src/components/ExpenseLogger.ts: Expense tracking component with form to record expenses by category, amount, and description, supports offline mode with local storage, and displays expense history table with category breakdown.
frontend/src/components/FuelTypeAnalytic: Displays comparative analytics for petrol vs diesel sales, showing volume, revenue, transaction counts, and percentage breakdowns for each fuel type.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Provides authentication UI with Internet Identity integration, handling login/logout actions and clearing query cache on logout.
frontend/src/components/OfflineStatusInd: Shows connection status, pending sync count, and sync progress with manual sync trigger; displays toast notifications for sync events.
frontend/src/components/PaymentFailure.t: Displays a failure message card when payment is cancelled or fails, with a button to return to dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PaymentSuccess.t: Displays a success message card when payment is processed successfully, with a button to return to dashboard.
frontend/src/components/PriceUpdateModul: Admin-only component for updating fuel prices and viewing price history; includes form for price updates and table showing historical price changes.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Onboarding form for new users to create their profile with name, phone number, and staff role selection.
frontend/src/components/ProfitLossDashbo: Financial overview dashboard showing total revenue, expenses, net profit/loss, profit margin, and breakdowns by fuel type.
frontend/src/components/SalesForm.tsx: React component for recording fuel sales with offline support. Handles fuel type selection, quantity input, staff assignment, and saves sales locally when offline before syncing to backend.
frontend/src/components/SalesReports.tsx: Sales reporting component that displays revenue analytics filtered by daily/weekly/monthly periods. Shows total revenue, fuel type breakdowns (petrol/diesel), volume metrics, and transaction lists.
Component for managing staff shifts with start/end shift functionality. Displays active shift details including staff member, start time, and sales count with real-time status updates.
frontend/src/components/ShiftReport.tsx: Displays detailed shift-wise reports in table format showing shift ID, staff, timestamps, sales count, and revenue. Includes fuel breakdown analysis (petrol/diesel) for individual shifts.
Staff management interface with CRUD operations for staff members. Validates Principal IDs, manages roles and commission rates, and includes permission checks for admin/manager access.
frontend/src/components/StockReconciliat: Displays a daily stock reconciliation table comparing opening stock, sales, calculated vs actual closing volumes, and variance for each fuel tank. Highlights variances exceeding 0.1L with color-coded badges.
frontend/src/components/TankMonitor.tsx: Provides a tank monitoring interface with dialogs to add new fuel tanks and update existing tank levels. Displays tank information with progress bars and handles mutations via React Query hooks.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state. Invalidates and refetches dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAutoSync.ts: Automatically triggers synchronization of offline data when connection is restored or backend becomes reachable. Prevents concurrent syncs and invalidates queries after successful sync.
Monitors both browser online status and backend reachability by periodically health-checking the actor. Tracks last successful connection time and provides manual health check function.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity authentication context with login/logout functionality and status tracking. Creates AuthClient with configurable options and manages identity state across the application.
frontend/src/hooks/useOfflineStorage.ts: Manages localStorage-based offline storage for sales and expenses. Provides functions to add, clear, and query pending offline data with automatic state synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useOnlineStatus.ts: Simple hook that tracks browser online/offline status using navigator.onLine and window events. Returns boolean indicating current connectivity state.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for all backend operations including user profiles, tanks, sales, expenses, staff, shifts, cash collections, price updates, fuel types, expense categories, Stripe configuration, shopping items, and offline data synchronization.
frontend/src/hooks/useSyncOfflineData.ts: Provides a hook for syncing offline sales and expenses data to the backend, tracking sync status, progress, errors, and pending item counts.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes, including colors for UI components, charts, and sidebar elements using OKLCH color space.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client, Internet Identity provider, and renders the root App component.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, storing, and managing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color schemes using OKLCH variables, container settings, border radius, animations, and plugin integrations for typography and container queries.
project_state.json: Project metadata tracking implemented features (owner/admin login, serial number updates) and pending feature requests for access control and Principal ID management in the Fuel Station Manager application.
